archetypes.name: risk-integration
archetypes.rationale: Several committed-log content contracts changed silently: *.failure-diag and dyn-*-codex-output.txt moved from always-committed to debug-gated, and voting-tally.md gets an include_excluded=true exception in design-log-publish.sh.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the behavioral breaks in committed log content that could silently regress audit consumers. In scripts/lib-design-round-artifacts.sh, *.failure-diag changed from always-included (return 0) to LARCH_FLUSH_DEBUG-gated — verify no audit-runs or downstream scan depends on vendor failure carriers in plan-review round dirs. In scripts/larch-log.sh, dyn-*-codex-output.txt changed from return 0 to debug-gated — check whether any CI script, audit scan, or documented consumer reads those files from committed implement logs. In scripts/design-log-publish.sh the voting-tally.md top-level loop sets _include_excluded=true to bypass the exclusion list; verify this exception is intentional and cannot allow other excluded basenames to leak through the same bypass path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: architecture
archetypes.rationale: The reviewer_signals producer in larch-log.sh must scan SOURCE_DIR before denial patterns run, the lib-prune-decision.sh normalize_prune_eligible two-call stdout pattern is easy to misread, and the plan mandates _write_prune_decision_env on every flush/exit path.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify the reviewer_signals composition in scripts/larch-log.sh: the Python block scans `src` (SOURCE_DIR) to build signals before any round_artifact_included denial runs — confirm `src` is the pre-exclusion source dir and not the already-filtered destination dir. In scripts/lib-prune-decision.sh, normalize_prune_eligible calls _prune_nonneg_int (which prints without a trailing newline) then a separate printf '\n' — verify callers capture the combined stdout correctly and no partial output escapes. Check that write_prune_decision_env uses tmp.$$ naming in a way that is safe when parallel dispatch processes write the same dest path (or confirm single-writer assumptions hold). Verify the plan's guarantee that _write_prune_decision_env is called before every exit path in dispatch-panel.sh and flush_round_log covers all seven call sites in review-core.sh. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
